newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC says Dragonair may list in 98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: CITIC says Dragonair may list in 98 - paper.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd managing director Henry Fan said the flotation of Hong Kong Dragon Airlines (Dragonair) could be arranged in 1998, the Sing Tao Daily reported on Wednesday.
The airline was expected to have good growth next year, he was quoted as saying, but the report did not elaborate. CITIC Pacific and Dragonair officials were not available to comment.
CITIC Pacific holds 28 percent of Dragonair.
In October, Fan said the Dragonair had decided to delay its Hong Kong listing plans until end-1997 at the earliest because 1996 earnings would not truly reflect the firm's growth.
The market had initially expected a listing before the end of 1996, later shifting to a listing in first quarter 1997.
China National Aviation Corp holds about 36 percent of Dragonair, while Swire Pacific Ltd and Cathay Pacific Ltd together hold about 26 percent.
